items.title: Cadence's New RTL Generation Agent Could Reshape AI-Driven Chip Design
items.summary: CDNS' new RTL Generation Agent automates chip design and optimization, delivering 24% lower area and 18% lower power in early evaluations.

items.title: Brokers Suggest Investing in Cadence (CDNS): Read This Before Placing a Bet
items.summary: The average brokerage recommendation (ABR) for Cadence (CDNS) is equivalent to a Buy. The overly optimistic recommendations of Wall Street analysts make the effectiveness of this highly sought-after metric questionable. So, is it worth buying the stock?

items.title: Cadence CEO Anirudh Devgan Sells 3,779 Shares for $1.1 Million
items.summary: Tax withholding obligations from restricted stock unit vesting drove the non-discretionary sale. Devgan retains 247,201 shares valued at $69.40 million.

items.title: Cadence Design Systems (CDNS) Stock Moves 2.61%: What You Should Know
items.summary: The latest trading day saw Cadence Design Systems (CDNS) settling at $302.6, representing a +2.61% change from its previous close.

items.title: What Happens To Synopsys Stock If AI Learns To Design Chips Without It?
items.summary: Synopsys (SNPS) sells the electronic design automation software and design IP that chipmakers use to build new chips. Its stock has lost 16.3% over the past year, while the S&P 500 gained 18.5%. A Needham analyst said on the fiscal Q3 2026 earnings call that the question investors keep asking is whether AI could learn to design chips without those tools. The biggest risk is not a sudden break. It is that Ansys revenue could hide the threat inside the headline totals while it builds.

items.title: The More Complicated Chips Become, the More Interesting Synopsys Gets
items.summary: Chip design complexity is hitting levels only a handful of software vendors can handle, and one under-the-radar name keeps collecting a toll on every advanced design that ships. The question is whether Wall Street has already priced in its edge or is still sleeping on it.

items.title: Why Has Synopsys Stopped Leading With Bad News?
items.summary: Two years of Synopsys (SNPS) earnings calls show management changing what it explains. The company used to open on problems, some outside its control and some its own. The August 2026 call is built around a joint product with Ansys, agentic AI, and a new way to charge for its design IP. Most of that switch is earned, but parts of it are still a promise.

items.title: How is Advanced Packaging Strengthening Cadence's Position?
items.summary: CDNS is benefiting from rising AI complexity, driving demand for advanced packaging, 3D-IC and differentiated IP.
